findings.title: The newly registered PostgreSQL suite spins on the microtask queue and never finishes
findings.detail: `while (answers === 1) await Promise.resolve();` sits in front of a real database round trip. A loop that enqueues a fresh microtask every turn starves the event loop's I/O phase, so the claim query result never arrives. PGlite settles through microtasks so the PGlite leg passes; real PostgreSQL does not.
findings.reproduction: bun test --timeout 300000 ./tests/postgres/factory-guest-model-journal.test.ts  # 7 min at 91% CPU, no output, killed (143)
findings.mechanismProof: /tmp/w01e-starvation-probe.ts on Bun 1.3.14: 'STARVED: 44332769 microtask turns in 3s, timer never fired'
findings.impact: Registered at .github/workflows/db-postgres.yml:184 inside one bun test invocation over 25 suites in a job with timeout-minutes: 15. The job dies by timeout, the five suites listed after it never run, and the if-no-files-found:error coverage upload gets nothing. Breaks a shared CI lane for every package.
findings.gateAffected: G5 checked with no real-PostgreSQL receipt anywhere in /tmp/factory-platform-evidence/w01e/
findings.fix: Await the observed operation: resolve a promise inside the provider double and await it, instead of spinning.

findings.title: The provider receipt digest is written in a shape FactoryUsageReconciliation refuses, and the promised reconcileLate path cannot execute
findings.detail: factoryProviderReceiptDigest returns bare 64-hex. RECEIPT_DIGEST_PATTERN is /^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/ and is enforced in both resolve and reconcile. The bare form is locked in at factory-guest-model-journal-suite.ts:57,108 and guest-model.podman.integration.test.ts:179. resolve also only selects operations in state 'uncertain'; this leaf settles 'completed' or 'failed'. Separately, guest-model-broker.ts:141-143 discards the completion when record throws, so nothing retains the digest and usage reconcile needs.
findings.unprovenClaim: Brief claim (c): no test in the leaf exercises FactoryUsageReconciliation at all.
findings.notAffected: The ordinary path is fine: a completed operation's measured usage is summed by validateFactoryTerminalUsage and settled at stop with source 'stop', which carries no receipt digest.
findings.fix: Emit sha256:${hex}, update the three assertions, and add a resolver test; or record in the freeze that W03c must normalise.

findings.title: FACTORY_GUEST_MODEL_LIMITS is not reachable from the SDK barrel
findings.detail: index.ts re-exports types.js with `export type *` and its explicit value list names FACTORY_LIMITS but not FACTORY_GUEST_MODEL_LIMITS. Verified against the built package: FACTORY_GUEST_MODEL_LIMITS is undefined, FACTORY_LIMITS is defined. The gate file's migration note and the freeze line both tell W10 and W11 to respect these bounds.
findings.fix: Add FACTORY_GUEST_MODEL_LIMITS to the value-export list on index.ts:3.
